identity.name: ASM Exposure-to-RCE: Internet-Exposed WSUS (CVE-2025-59287) → Domain Recon → Webhook Exfil — Correlation (SIM-ASM-005)
identity.summary: Cortex ASM/Xpanse finds an internet-exposed WSUS interface (8530/8531) at rest; the WSUS service (wsusservice.exe / w3wp.exe) is then driven via CVE-2025-59287 deserialization to spawn cmd→powershell, run domain recon, and beacon to webhook.site. XSIAM correlation joins the ASM finding, the ABIOC/BIOC shell-spawn, the recon burst, and the NGFW exfil into ONE exposure→RCE→discovery→exfil incident.
identity.description: Unit 42 reports mass opportunistic exploitation of CVE-2025-59287, an unsafe-deserialization remote code execution in Windows Server Update Services (WSUS). WSUS listens on TCP 8530 (HTTP) and 8531 (HTTPS); the GetCookie() endpoint deserializes an attacker-controlled AuthorizationCookie via BinaryFormatter and the ReportingWebService deserializes via SoapFormatter, both without type restriction — a payload runs as the WSUS service. Cortex Xpanse identified roughly 5,500 internet-exposed WSUS instances, making internet reachability the decisive exposure. Post-exploitation the operator's initial payload runs domain reconnaissance (whoami, net user /domain, ipconfig /all) to map the domain and high-value accounts, then exfiltrates the collected host/domain context to an attacker-controlled webhook.site endpoint using PowerShell Invoke-WebRequest with a curl.exe fallback. The observed process lineages are wsusservice.exe → cmd.exe → cmd.exe → powershell.exe and w3wp.exe (running under the wsuspool IIS application pool) → cmd.exe → cmd.exe → powershell.exe. Affected: Windows Server 2012 through 2025 (including 23H2) with the WSUS role enabled. This card is the ASM-plane dual-control proof for that chain: it is emphatically a CORRELATION scenario (methodology family F2, Causality Stitching Validation). Cortex ASM/Xpanse supplies the exposure-at-rest half (asm_findings: a WSUS management interface reachable from the internet on 8530/8531); the Cortex XDR agent supplies the runtime half (xdr_data: an update service that never normally parents an interactive interpreter suddenly spawns cmd→powershell, then a domain-discovery burst); the NGFW supplies the exfil half (panw_ngfw_traffic_raw: outbound HTTP to webhook.site). An ABIOC anchors the WSUS-service-spawns-shell deviation to the causality chain; a hand-authored BIOC reproduces Unit 42's published hunting logic (child processes of wsusservice.exe / w3wp.exe filtering legitimate children such as svchost.exe, conhost.exe, csc.exe); validation/hunt XQL surfaces the discovery burst, the webhook.site egress, and the ASM finding; and the terminal correlation rule CR-ASM-0005 joins all four signals on the shared host/IP into a single exposure→RCE→discovery→exfil incident the DC presents as the exposure-management readout.

campaigns: Opportunistic mass exploitation of internet-exposed WSUS via CVE-2025-59287 (2025)

execution.framework_reference_id: SIM-ASM-005 — Internet-exposed WSUS (CVE-2025-59287) exposure-to-RCE-to-exfil correlation stitch for Cortex ASM + XDR + NGFW dual-control validation

payload.code:
# SAFE-MODE, non-destructive. Emits the exposure->RCE->discovery->exfil signal
# shape without exploiting a real WSUS deserialization flaw and without
# beaconing to attacker infrastructure. On a Windows target the per-step
# platform_variants produce the real wsusservice/w3wp -> cmd -> powershell
# lineage, the read-only domain-discovery burst, and an egress to an authorised
# local collector (STAGE_HOST) that stands in for webhook.site.
set -euo pipefail
echo '[CortexSim][SAFE-MODE] SIM-ASM-005 exposure-to-RCE correlation marker'

input_variables.name: STAGE_HOST
input_variables.description: Authorised local collector the SAFE-MODE exfil step reaches instead of the real webhook.site indicator (no beacon to attacker infrastructure).

expected_artifacts.description: An update-service process (wsusservice.exe or w3wp.exe under the wsuspool app pool) parenting a cmd.exe -> powershell.exe interpreter chain it never spawns during normal update synchronisation.
expected_artifacts.expected_value: causality_actor_process_image_name in (wsusservice.exe, w3wp.exe) and action_process_image_name in (cmd.exe, powershell.exe)

expected_artifacts.description: A domain-discovery burst (whoami, net user /domain, ipconfig /all) parented under the exploited WSUS process lineage.
Outbound HTTP session from the WSUS host to a webhook.site collector carrying the exfiltrated host/domain context.

iocs.context: Attacker-controlled webhook.site collector URL Unit 42 observed receiving the exfiltrated domain-reconnaissance output; published defanged as hxxp://webhook[.]site/22b6b8c8-2e07-4878-a681-b772e569aa6a in the source report, stored fanged/matchable here so a tenant indicator feed can match live NGFW/proxy telemetry.

biocs.name: ASM-005 WSUS Deserialization RCE Update Service Spawns Interpreter Chain
biocs.description: Hand-authored reproduction of Unit 42's published hunting logic for CVE-2025-59287: the WSUS service (wsusservice.exe) or the wsuspool IIS worker (w3wp.exe) spawns a command interpreter (cmd.exe / powershell.exe), filtering the legitimate children a healthy WSUS host produces (svchost.exe, conhost.exe, csc.exe). Any surviving child is the deserialization payload executing as the update service.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = "wsusservice.exe" or (actor_process_image_name = "w3wp.exe" and lowercase(actor_process_command_line) contains "wsuspool")
| filter action_process_image_name in ("cmd.exe", "powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
| filter action_process_image_name not in ("svchost.exe", "conhost.exe", "csc.exe", "cscript.exe")
| comp count() as payload_spawns by agent_hostname, actor_process_image_name, action_process_image_name
| filter payload_spawns >= 1
| fields agent_hostname, actor_process_image_name, action_process_image_name, payload_spawns

abiocs.name: ASM-005 WSUS Service Identity Spawns Out-of-Baseline Command Shell
abiocs.description: The WSUS update service identity — wsusservice.exe, or w3wp.exe running under the wsuspool application pool — whose learned Cortex behavioral profile is periodic update-synchronisation traffic and never an interactive interpreter, suddenly parents a cmd.exe/powershell.exe chain. The auto-tuned ABIOC fires on the deviation from the service identity's learned process baseline and anchors it to the causality chain (internet-exposed WSUS -> deserialization exploit -> shell), catching the CVE-2025-59287 payload without a signature for any specific command.
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = "wsusservice.exe" or (causality_actor_process_image_name = "w3wp.exe" and causality_actor_process_command_line contains "wsuspool")
| filter action_process_image_name in ("cmd.exe", "powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
| comp count() as out_of_baseline_shells by agent_hostname, causality_actor_process_image_name, actor_effective_username
| filter out_of_baseline_shells >= 1
| fields agent_hostname, causality_actor_process_image_name, actor_effective_username, out_of_baseline_shells
abiocs.causality_anchor: Learned WSUS-service baseline (periodic update synchronisation, no interactive interpreter) -> internet-exposed WSUS management interface -> deserialization RCE -> out-of-baseline cmd/powershell lineage, anchored to the WSUS service as causality group owner.

xql_queries.name: ASM-005 Internet-Exposed WSUS Management Interface Discovered
xql_queries.query:
dataset = asm_findings
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 3600)
| filter dst_port in (8530, 8531)
| filter service in ("wsus", "http", "https") or finding_class = "internet-exposed-management-interface"
| comp count_distinct(resource_id) as exposed_wsus_assets by resource_id, dst_port
| filter exposed_wsus_assets >= 1
| fields resource_id, dst_port, exposed_wsus_assets

xql_queries.name: ASM-005 Domain Recon Burst Under WSUS Process Lineage
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 900)
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name in ("wsusservice.exe", "w3wp.exe")
| filter action_process_image_name in ("whoami.exe", "net.exe", "net1.exe", "ipconfig.exe", "nltest.exe")
| comp count_distinct(action_process_image_name) as recon_tools by agent_hostname, causality_actor_process_instance_id
| filter recon_tools >= 2
| fields agent_hostname, causality_actor_process_instance_id, recon_tools

xql_queries.name: ASM-005 Webhook Site Exfil Egress From WSUS Host
xql_queries.query:
dataset = panw_ngfw_traffic_raw
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 900)
| filter dst_host contains "webhook.site" or uri contains "webhook.site"
| filter app in ("web-browsing", "ssl", "http")
| comp count() as exfil_sessions by src_ip, dst_host, app
| filter exfil_sessions >= 1
| fields src_ip, dst_host, app, exfil_sessions

correlation_rules.name: ASM-005 Internet-Exposed WSUS Exploited to Domain Recon to Webhook Exfil — Exposure-to-RCE Incident Stitch
correlation_rules.logic: Fuses four signals on the SAME host/IP within the correlation window into one exposure->RCE->discovery->exfil incident: (a) the Cortex ASM/Xpanse exposure-at-rest finding from XQL(ASM-005 Internet-Exposed WSUS Management Interface Discovered) on asm_findings (dst_port 8530/8531); (b) the runtime exploit, where ABIOC(ASM-005 WSUS Service Identity Spawns Out-of-Baseline Command Shell) and BIOC(ASM-005 WSUS Deserialization RCE Update Service Spawns Interpreter Chain) both fire on the WSUS-service cmd/powershell lineage; (c) the domain-discovery burst from XQL(ASM-005 Domain Recon Burst Under WSUS Process Lineage); and (d) the outbound collector session from XQL(ASM-005 Webhook Site Exfil Egress From WSUS Host) on panw_ngfw_traffic_raw. Joined on agent_hostname/src_ip, the rule raises a single exposure-management incident. This is the dual-control proof: exposure management flags the asset at rest, runtime catches the exploit, and only the platform draws the line between them.

threat_scenarios.name: Exposure-to-RCE Dual-Control — Internet-Exposed WSUS Correlation (CVE-2025-59287)
threat_scenarios.description: Prove that Cortex's exposure-management plane (ASM/Xpanse) and its runtime detection plane (XDR + NGFW) independently observe an internet-exposed WSUS exploitation chain, and that only the XSIAM correlation engine draws the line between the exposure at rest and the runtime exploit — raising a single exposure→RCE→discovery→exfil incident a DC presents in the executive readout.

threat_steps.objective: Cortex ASM surfaces the internet-exposed WSUS interface and XDR fires the WSUS-service-spawns-shell ABIOC and BIOC on the runtime exploit.
preconditions: WSUS host inventoried by ASM/Xpanse with an internet-exposed 8530/8531 finding.
Cortex XDR agent installed on the WSUS host.
steps: Confirm the asm_findings exposure at rest.
Drive the SAFE-MODE wsusservice/w3wp -> cmd -> powershell lineage.
Observe ABIOC and BIOC fire on the WSUS-service interpreter chain.
success_criteria: ABIOC `ASM-005 WSUS Service Identity Spawns Out-of-Baseline Command Shell` fires.
BIOC `ASM-005 WSUS Deserialization RCE Update Service Spawns Interpreter Chain` fires.
The ASM exposed-WSUS finding is present on the same host.

threat_steps.objective: The domain-recon burst and webhook.site egress are observed and the terminal correlation stitches all four signals into one incident.
preconditions: WSUS host outbound traffic transits a Palo Alto NGFW forwarding to XSIAM.
steps: Run the SAFE-MODE domain-discovery burst under the WSUS lineage.
Emit the SAFE-MODE egress to the authorised collector standing in for webhook.site.
Observe CR-ASM-0005 raise a single exposure-to-RCE incident.
success_criteria: XQL `ASM-005 Domain Recon Burst Under WSUS Process Lineage` returns the discovery burst.
XQL `ASM-005 Webhook Site Exfil Egress From WSUS Host` returns the egress session.
Correlation `CR-ASM-0005` raises exactly one stitched exposure→RCE→discovery→exfil incident.

preventive_controls: Remove WSUS from the internet — WSUS 8530/8531 should never be reachable from untrusted networks; restrict to management VLANs and require VPN for remote administration.
Apply Microsoft's out-of-band fix for CVE-2025-59287 and, where the WSUS role is not required, disable it or uninstall it.
Run the WSUS service under a least-privilege identity and block outbound internet egress from update-infrastructure hosts so a deserialization payload cannot beacon out.
detection_engineering: Alert on any WSUS service identity (wsusservice.exe / w3wp.exe under wsuspool) parenting a command interpreter — a healthy WSUS host never spawns cmd.exe/powershell.exe.
Let Cortex auto-tune an ABIOC against the WSUS service's learned process baseline rather than enumerating individual post-exploit commands.

Correlate the ASM exposed-asset finding with the runtime interpreter chain, the domain-discovery burst, and the webhook.site egress on the shared host/IP so exposure and exploit surface as one incident, not four disconnected alerts.
